dataset_name: Image-to-Text Bilingual Dataset from Medical Prescriptions
content_type: Mixed printed clinic header and handwritten Rx lines
download_method: Direct HTTPS download from Mendeley Data API
hardware_requirements: CPU for inference, GPU (>=8GB VRAM) for fine-tuning
compatibility: Compatible with Python PIL and PyTorch/Paddle
known_limitations: Variable resolution; skewed lighting in clinic photos
recommended_use: Prescription handwriting line recognition and evaluation

content_type: Doctor handwritten medicine names, doses, frequencies
annotation_format: Bounding box TXT / XML coordinates + transcriptions
download_method: Zenodo REST API / HTTPS direct download
compatibility: Compatible with Hugging Face datasets and PyTorch
known_limitations: Cursive physician script requires specialized tokenizers
recommended_use: Doctor handwriting recognition benchmark and model fine-tuning

content_type: Doctor prescriptions with medicine list and dosing
compatibility: Directly integrates with Python OpenCV and Tesseract 5
known_limitations: Small evaluation corpus; requires data augmentation
recommended_use: Evaluation set for printed and semi-cursive prescription OCR

content_type: Mixed doctor prescriptions and outpatient slips
annotation_format: Hugging Face Arrow / Parquet with OCR text
hardware_requirements: CPU for loading; GPU for Donut/TrOCR
known_limitations: Some synthetic templates included; must filter real vs synthetic
recommended_use: Document classification and medicine entity extraction training

content_type: Printed clinical pathology reports (CBC, Biochemistry, Urine)
annotation_format: Table structure JSON + bounding boxes for (Test, Value, Range, Unit)
compatibility: Native integration with PaddleOCR table recognition
known_limitations: Bilingual headings; table grid lines vary across hospitals
recommended_use: Laboratory report table extraction and reference interval parsing

content_type: Pathology, hematology, and biochemistry PDF scans
annotation_format: Structured CSV / JSON (Test Name, Result, Reference Range, Flag)
model_architecture: PyMuPDF + Tesseract OCR + Regular Expression Parser
compatibility: Directly matches existing Praveen/AI-Engine pipeline architecture
known_limitations: Focuses on standard column tables; struggles with multi-column wraps
recommended_use: Benchmark evaluation for LOINC matching and abnormal flag detection
